name: python
description: Install Python 3.12.2 with pip, and remove virtualenv where an earlier provisioning run installed it -- it was dropped for the stdlib venv module (#131), which needs no install and no network. Runs on EVERY unit: no host sets 'modules' in server/unit-registry.json, so the earlier 'Pinned to mastw/mast00' misstated this module's blast radius. provide-jupyter.ps1 (order 2050) is the consumer: it creates its contained venv with python -m venv, so verify asserts a venv can actually be created rather than that a module imports.
